subject: radiology
title: TIPS technique: puncture to patency

steps.tx: Necks open the highway to livers. **Right jugular access** under ultrasound guides sheaths down the cava into **hepatic veins**, usually the right branch for its straight run. **Wedge venography** puffs contrast that outlines portal branches as a roadmap for puncture. **Colapinto needles** curve from hepatic vein toward portal bifurcation under biplane guidance. **Failed hepatic veins** from Budd-Chiari reroute through caudate or direct caval sticks.
steps.say: Necks open the highway to livers. Right jugular sheaths run down into hepatic veins, usually the right branch. Wedge contrast outlines portal branches as puncture maps. Curved needles pass from hepatic vein toward portal bifurcation. Blocked hepatic veins reroute through caudate or direct caval sticks.

steps.tx: Gradients decide dilatation endpoints. **Portosystemic gradient** measured before and after sets the target below **12 mmHg** per Baveno consensus, where bleeding and ascites ease. **Covered stent-grafts** line the parenchymal tract, cutting dysfunction against bare metal under CIRSE-aligned practice. **Balloon dilatation** opens tracts stepwise while oversized balloons tear capsules into bleeds. **Variceal embolisation alongside** coils bleeding coronaries that shunts alone may not still.
steps.say: Gradients decide endpoints. Pressure drops target below twelve millimetres of mercury where bleeding and ascites ease. Covered stent-grafts line tracts, resisting dysfunction better than bare metal. Stepwise balloon opening avoids capsular tears. Coils close bleeding varices that shunts alone may not still.

steps.tx: Bleeding punctures declare themselves fast. **Capsular transgression** spills contrast outside livers with falling pressure, demanding covered extension or embolisation. **Biliary fistulae** from crossed ducts declare with fever and need antibiotics with drainage. **Arterial injury** alongside tracts shows as blushes needing coils. **Stent malposition** into cava or atria pulls back or extends under cardiac watching.

steps.tx: Patency proves itself on Doppler. **Post-TIPS duplex** checks shunt velocity with direction of portal flow within days, then at surveillance intervals. **Falling velocities with recurrent ascites** mark stenosis needing venography with revision. **Variceal re-bleeds** after shunts re-map for shunt versus varix failure. **Lifelong liver follow-up** continues since shunts palliate pressure rather than curing cirrhosis.
